questions.q: 1. Anu spends 80% of his income.if his income increased by 12% and the savings decreased by 10% then what is the percent increase in the expenditure?
questions.s:
1.(a) Let the original income = ₹100

ATQ,

                Income = expenditure + saving 

Original       100   =      80           +     20

New             112   =      94            +    18

Percentage increase in the expenditure = 94 - 8080 × 100 =

1480 × 100 = 17.5%

questions.q: 7. 20% of the inhabitants of a village having died of malaria, a panic set in, during which 30% of the remaining inhabitants left the village. The population was then reduced to 12,000. What was the number of inhabitants initially (Consider integral part only) ?
questions.s:
7.(b)
Let the total number of inhabitants initially be x.
20% died, remaining inhabitants = 80100x
30% of them left the village = 30100 × 80100x
Now, remaining inhabitants = 80100x - 30100 × 80100x
 80100x - 30100 × 80100x = 12000
⇒ 56100x = 12000
 ⇒ x = 21428
So, the total number of inhabitants initially was 21,428.

questions.q: In an election, a voter has choice to vote for one candidate out of three candidates. There is also an option 'None of The Above' [NOTA] to reject all candidates. The three candidates get votes that are 6 times NOTA. The winner gets votes that are twice the second runner-up's votes. The first runner up gets 900 votes more than NOTA and defeats the second runner-up by 150 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?
o: 17715
15177
11025
11577
questions.s:
Solution
Winner = W
1st Runner up = R1
2nd Runner up = R2
Nota = N
R1= R2 + 150 ⇒R1 = N+900
R2=Nota+750⇒ R2 = N + 750
W=2 [Nota+750]⇒ W = 2N + 1500
Total votes = 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 + N
Total votes = 5N + 3150
Also given that, 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 = 6N
N = 1575
Total no of votes =3150+5×1575=11025

questions.q:
A number is multiplied by 5/8 instead of 2/5. What is the percentage error in the calculation?

किसी संख्या को 2/5 के बजाय 5/8 से गुणा किया जाता है। गणना में प्रतिशत त्रुटि क्या है?
questions.s:
Let the number be x.

Wrong value = 5x/8

Corrected value = 2x/5

Hence, the required percentage = [(5x/8 - 2x/5) * 100]/ (2x/5)

= (9x/40 * 100)/ (2x/5)

= 56.25%

questions_hin.q_hi: 7. एक गाँव के 20% निवासियों की मलेरिया से मृत्यु हो गई, एक दहशत पैदा हो गई, जिसके दौरान, बचे हुए निवासियों में से 30% निवासियों ने गाँव छोड़ दिया। तब गाँव की जनसंख्या 12,000 हो गई। प्रारंभ में निवासियों की संख्या क्या थी ? (उत्तर पूर्ण संख्या तक ज्ञात कीजिए)
questions_hin.s_hi:
7.(b)
माना, प्रारंभ में कुल निवासियों की संख्या x है।
20% की मृत्यु हो गई, शेष निवासी = 80100x
उनमें से 30% ने गांव छोड़ दिया, 30100 × 80100x
अब, शेष निवासी = 80100x - 30100 × 80100x
80100x - 30100 × 80100x = 12000
⇒ 56100x = 12000
⇒ x = 21428
अतः प्रारंभ में निवासियों की कुल संख्या 21,428 थी।

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election, a voter has choice to vote for one candidate out of three candidates. There is also an option 'None of The Above' [NOTA] to reject all candidates. The three candidates get votes that are 6 times NOTA. The winner gets votes that are twice the second runner-up's votes. The first runner up gets 900 votes more than NOTA and defeats the second runner-up by 150 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?
o_hi: 17715
15177
11025
11577
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution
Winner = W
1st Runner up = R1
2nd Runner up = R2
Nota = N
R1= R2 + 150 ⇒R1 = N+900
R2=Nota+750⇒ R2 = N + 750
W=2 [Nota+750]⇒ W = 2N + 1500
Total votes = 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 + N
Total votes = 5N + 3150
Also given that, 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 = 6N
N = 1575
Total no of votes =3150+5×1575=11025

questions_hin.q_hi: 3. यदि (x - y) का 45% = (x +y) का 30%, तो x का कितना प्रतिशत y है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
3.(d)

45% of (x - y) = 30% of (x + y)

45x - 45y = 30x + 30y

15x = 75y

x : y = 5 : 1

आवश्यक प्रतिशत= 15×100 = 20%

questions_hin.q_hi:
A number is multiplied by 5/8 instead of 2/5. What is the percentage error in the calculation?

किसी संख्या को 2/5 के बजाय 5/8 से गुणा किया जाता है। गणना में प्रतिशत त्रुटि क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the number be x.

Wrong value = 5x/8

Corrected value = 2x/5

Hence, the required percentage = [(5x/8 - 2x/5) * 100]/ (2x/5)

= (9x/40 * 100)/ (2x/5)

= 56.25%

questions_hin.q_hi: 8. यदि दो संख्याएँ 45 : 56 के अनुपात में हैं, तो पहली संख्या दूसरी संख्या से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है?

8.(a) माना, दो संख्याएं p और q हैं।

प्रश्न के अनुसार,
